    In a 2026 Women's NCAA Final Four matchup, the
    UCLA Bruins defeated the Texas Longhorns 51-44 on April 3, 2026, advancing to their first national championship game. Lauren Betts led UCLA with 16 points and 11 rebounds, while Kyla Oldacre paced Texas with 11 points. 
    UCLA Bruins Key Player Stats (Final Four 2026) 
    Lauren Betts: 16 points, 11 rebounds, 3 blocks. 
    Kiki Rice: 11 points. 
    Gianna Kneepkens: 10 points. 
    Gabriela Jaquez: 10 points. 
    Texas Longhorns Key Player Stats (Final Four 2026) 
    • Kyla Oldacre: 11 points, 7 rebounds.
    • Rori Harmon: 4 steals.
    • Madison Booker: Held to low shooting percentage (1-for-11 in the first half). 
    Team Stats 
    • Final Score: UCLA 51, Texas 44.
    • Field Goals: Texas 20-of-65 (
      ), UCLA 18-of-44 (
      ).
    • Rebounds: UCLA 37, Texas 36.
    • Turnovers: UCLA 23, Texas 12. 
    UCLA's defense dominated, holding Texas to low shooting percentages, while Lauren Betts proved pivotal in the paint to secure the victory.
